description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to the number of ingredient counters on Communal Brewing.
If Cryptic Trilobite has more than one +1/+1 counter on it, activate it by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
If Cryptic Trilobite doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it, it dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
If Cryptic Trilobite died, Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4 as needed until Cryptic Trilobite is in your hand.
Repeat from step 1.
